Open Targets 2026.06 scores the TRAF3IP2-psoriasis association at 0.67

hyp1.note: one claim per gene (IL12B, IL23R, TYK2); the mechanism says IL-23 signalling through IL23R and TYK2 drives Th17 expansion and psoriatic plaques. IL12B and IL23R reach TYK2 only through unsigned binds steps, so only the TYK2 claim can have a route

hyp2.note: sign from the title ('mediates downstream inflammatory signaling') and mechanism ('essential intracellular adaptor for the IL-17 receptor'), matching the falsification (knockout expected to prevent hyperplasia); the mechanism's own variant wording is undirected ('alter', 'dysregulated'), and it names variants, but the chain starts at the gene. Aspect progression: the mechanism's disease outcome is 'exacerbation of psoriatic skin inflammation' (the guide lists exacerbation under progression; nothing in the title or mechanism speaks of susceptibility), although the chain's disease step is a GWAS susceptibility association (risk). Claim 2: the title names no disease, only 'downstream inflammatory signaling', and the falsification reads out 'Cytokine'; the chain's one signed step ends there (hyp2.1), so the title's own claim is recorded against that end node

findings.detail: the run grounds only psoriasis (MONDO:0005083); all four gene nodes and 'Cytokine' have an empty curie, though each gene symbol resolves to one UniProt entry
'Cytokine' (kind protein) names a whole class of proteins, not one protein; grounded here as GO:0001816 cytokine production
hyp2.1 ends at 'Cytokine' and hyp2.2 starts again at TRAF3IP2: two parallel edges from the gene, with no step from cytokines to psoriasis
the title and mechanism hinge on Th17 expansion, but no step names Th17 cells; the chain goes binds, binds, then TYK2 leads_to psoriasis directly
the mechanism says the binding 'recruits and activates' TYK2, but both steps are binds with polarity unknown, so IL12B and IL23R have no signed route to psoriasis
TRAF3IP2's only edge to psoriasis is an association with polarity unknown, so the hypothesis has no signed route to the disease
none of the three citations states that TYK2 causes psoriasis: an undirected Open Targets score, a variant GWAS row, and a ChEMBL record; the step ends with no evidence
the ChEMBL record (deucravacitinib targets TYK2, approved) gives neither the indication nor the action type, so it cannot say that blocking TYK2 treats psoriasis
the only citation is an MGI 'abnormal cytokine secretion' annotation of a mouse Traf3ip2 knockout: undirected, so it cannot support 'increases_amount (+)'

the rs34536443 row names G as the risk allele at frequency 0.953 (so the minor allele is the protective one), but the run never says what either allele does to TYK2, so the row cannot sign a gene-level effect

the rs33980500 row gives a direction for the T allele (OR 1.52, missense), but the step leaves polarity unknown and the mechanism only says variants 'alter' signalling, so the direction never reaches TRAF3IP2
supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence are empty for both hypotheses; all citations sit on chain steps, and no contradicting evidence was sought
the budget asks for min_hypotheses 3 but the run returns 2 hypotheses; the other three genes (EGFL8, GLE1, UHRF2) go to the abstention

the abstention cites five accessions (GWAS:GLE1:no-association, GWAS:UHRF2:no-association, two HPA records, rs3117182) that are not in sources.json, and its key claim, EGFL8's signal being LD with HLA-C*06:02, cites nothing that states LD; none of it can be checked here

the mechanism's disease outcome is 'exacerbation of psoriatic skin inflammation' (progression, claimed as such), but the chain's only disease step is a GWAS susceptibility association (risk), so even a signed hyp2.2 would not reach the claim

the falsification's readout is 'Cytokine' (it tests hyp2.1); its description adds 'prevent epidermal hyperplasia in a psoriasis model', a disease feature no step names, and a knockout inside a disease model tests course, not the susceptibility association of hyp2.2

the IL23R-TYK2 STRING edge has experimental score 0.00 and rests on database 0.80 and text-mining 0.90; the corpus UniProt records (not cited by the run, so not used as evidence) say IL23R 'Interacts with JAK2' (Q5VWK5) and list TYK2's receptor chains as IFNAR1, IL12RB1, IL10RB or IL13RA1 (P29597), so the chain likely skips IL12RB1

no corpus term of a usable kind names the protein class 'cytokine' (NCIT:C20464 has no kind in render.py, PR and CHEBI have no class term), so 'increases_amount Cytokine' became an effect on the process GO:0001816 cytokine production

the guide makes a STRING edge with database >= 0.15 curatedDb (weight 4/5) for binds, but the database channel includes pathway co-membership; IL23R-TYK2 has experimental 0.00 and still counts as curated binding
S5 keeps both the GCST005527 GWAS row and the Open Targets score whose genetic_association part (0.93) very likely rests on the same GWAS, so the evidence may double-count
the evidence-kind table has no row for an Open Targets aggregate score (genetic, literature and clinical parts mixed); kept as observational for an unsigned association

no form says that a binding is the means of activation (ligand binds receptor, receptor recruits and activates kinase), so a receptor-signalling chain is either unsigned binds or needs separate activates steps the run did not write
the format has no place for the run's abstention (genes covered, reason, cited evidence), so its claims about EGFL8, GLE1 and UHRF2 are recorded only as a finding

audit.reason: the claim's aspect comes from what the hypothesis asserts; the mechanism's only disease outcome is 'exacerbation of psoriatic skin inflammation', a word the guide's aspect table puts under progression (severity, 'worsens a feature', is the only other reading), and neither title nor mechanism mentions susceptibility or onset. The curator took risk from the chain's GWAS step, which makes the claim agree with the chain instead of recording that they differ. No route either way, so the counts are unchanged

audit.reason: the title ('TRAF3IP2 mediates downstream inflammatory signaling in target cells') names no disease, and the falsification's readout is 'Cytokine'; the chain's only signed step (hyp2.1) ends at that node and does not lead on to psoriasis. Without the claim, the report hid that the hypothesis's headline claim has no supporting evidence

audit.before: aspect_ambiguous: the mechanism ends at exacerbation (severity or progression) while the chain's disease step is risk
audit.after: aspect_mismatch: claim is progression, the chain's only disease step is risk, so even a signed hyp2.2 would not reach the claim
audit.reason: follows the aspect fix: the mismatch between the mechanism's outcome and the chain's evidence is now a result, not an ambiguity

audit.before: the falsification reads out 'Cytokine' ... and says nothing about the TRAF3IP2-psoriasis link
audit.after: readout 'Cytokine' tests hyp2.1; the description also says 'prevent epidermal hyperplasia in a psoriasis model', a disease feature no step names, testing course rather than the susceptibility association
audit.reason: the run's falsification description reads 'block IL-17-dependent production of inflammatory cytokines and prevent epidermal hyperplasia in a psoriasis model', so 'says nothing about the TRAF3IP2-psoriasis link' was false as written

audit.before: TYK2 pairs with IL12RB1 and JAK2 with IL23R 'from curator knowledge (not a cited source, not used)'
audit.after: same point, grounded in the corpus UniProt records: Q5VWK5 'Interacts with JAK2'; P29597 lists TYK2-associated chains IFNAR1, IL12RB1, IL10RB, IL13RA1
audit.reason: terms.py UniProt:Q5VWK5 and UniProt:P29597 state it, so the finding is checkable rather than resting on memory; still not run-cited, so S2's evidence is unchanged

every step of both hypotheses cites something; the finding is about empty supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence lists for both hypotheses, and no_citation elsewhere in the corpus means a step that cites nothing, so it would be miscounted
